validation_test_cases.title: Basic Equal-Weight Sanity Check
validation_test_cases.description: Validate that equal-weight strategy allocates equal capital across all assets
acceptance_criteria: Optimized weights must sum to 100%
No optimized weight should be negative
Each security should have equal allocation (50% each for 2 assets)
validation_test_cases.expected_behavior: Both IEFA and SPY should receive 50% allocation

validation_test_cases.title: Risk-Based Allocation Across Different Asset Classes
validation_test_cases.description: Validate risk parity strategy equalizes risk contributions
acceptance_criteria: Optimized weights must sum to 100%
No optimized weight should be negative
Risk contributions should be approximately equal across assets
Small floating-point differences below 0.1% are acceptable
validation_test_cases.expected_behavior: Risk parity rebalances from initial 25/75 split to equal risk contributions

validation_test_cases.title: Lowest-Risk Portfolio Construction
validation_test_cases.description: Validate minimize volatility strategy finds minimum variance portfolio
acceptance_criteria: Optimized weights must sum to 100%
No optimized weight should be negative
Optimized portfolio volatility must be less than or equal to current portfolio volatility
Small floating-point differences below 0.1% are acceptable
validation_test_cases.expected_behavior: Portfolio rebalances to minimize total volatility

validation_test_cases.title: Risk-Adjusted Return Optimization
validation_test_cases.description: Validate Sharpe ratio maximization balances return and risk
acceptance_criteria: Optimized weights must sum to 100%
No optimized weight should be negative
Optimized Sharpe ratio must be greater than or equal to current portfolio Sharpe ratio
Small floating-point differences below 0.1% are acceptable
validation_test_cases.expected_behavior: Portfolio rebalances to maximize risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe ratio)

validation_test_cases.title: Portfolio-Level and Security-Level Constraint Handling
validation_test_cases.description: Validate constraints: Min Dividend Yield 2.50%; security bounds min 5%, max 40%
acceptance_criteria: Optimized weights must sum to 100%
No optimized weight should be negative
Each security weight must be between 5% and 40% (inclusive)
Portfolio dividend yield must be >= 2.50%
Optimized Sharpe ratio must be maximized subject to constraints
If constraints are infeasible, API should return HTTP 400 with clear error message
Small floating-point differences below 0.1% are acceptable
validation_test_cases.expected_behavior: Portfolio respects all constraints while maximizing Sharpe ratio

validation_test_cases.title: Momentum Factor Exposure
validation_test_cases.description: Validate factor exposure optimization for Momentum (Bonus case)
acceptance_criteria: Optimized weights must sum to 100%
No optimized weight should be negative
Response must include factor betas for both current and optimized portfolios
Factor betas should include: momentum, size, value (lowercase keys)
Momentum exposure in optimized portfolio should be >= current portfolio momentum exposure
Small floating-point differences below 0.1% are acceptable
validation_test_cases.expected_behavior: Portfolio rebalances to maximize momentum factor exposure; returns factor betas

validation_guidelines.tolerance_description: Differences below 0.1% (0.001 in decimal) are acceptable between live tool and API
response_requirements: security_name: Full name of the security
change: Difference between optimized and current weights
min_weight: Security-level minimum bound (if constraints present)
max_weight: Security-level maximum bound (if constraints present)
validation_guidelines.error_handling: If constraints are infeasible, API must return HTTP 400 with validation error details instead of silently producing invalid weights
